title: China Price Check: Versailles $39 vs Forbidden City $9 | China Travel Expert
description:
Two of the world's great palaces, two very different ticket prices. The Palace of Versailles charges about $39 for a full Passport ticket in high season. Beijing's Forbidden City? Around $9 — roughly four times less for the same tier of full adult entry.

Here are this week's numbers, same season (both sites are in their April-October high season right now):
• Versailles Passport (palace, Trianon & gardens), standard non-EEA adult: €35 ≈ $39
• Forbidden City standard adult: ¥60 (April 1-October 31) ≈ $9; it drops to ¥40 from November 1
That is about a 4.4x gap. Converted at roughly 6.75 CNY and 1.13 USD per euro (mid/late-October 2026 range; a 1% FX move does not change the multiple).

🧭 Expert Tip: the Forbidden City sells no same-day tickets. Booking opens online 7 days ahead at 20:00 Beijing time, one real-name ticket per passport per day — set a reminder. More China Price Checks every Wednesday & Sunday.
